protocol: Frozen refined N100/S10 primary chirality-filtered selector, three inference repeats. Native OST2.8.0 RMSD<2A and LDDT-PLI>0.8 are separate and same-pose conjunction endpoints.
scope: Outcome-blind accession/date membership. Post-cutoff slice is included in the unshared-accession group, not an independent cohort. Accession sharing is not identity of the protein-ligand complex; nonsharing and later release do not establish novel sequence, ligand, binding pocket, or independence from all predecessor exposure. No causal effect of training exposure is inferred.
denominator: Confirmed successes over every stratum complex, with unresolved native endpoints separately counted; rates are means and sample SD across three fixed-weight repeats.
training_scope: 47277 released docking fine-tuning loader samples; not the union of every predecessor training exposure.
